papers.title: Active Nearest-Neighbor Learning in Metric Spaces
papers.abstract: We propose a pool-based non-parametric active learning algorithm for general metric spaces, called MArgin Regularized Metric Active Nearest Neighbor (MARMANN), which outputs a nearest-neighbor classifier. We give prediction error guarantees that depend on the noisy-margin properties of the input sample, and are competitive with those obtained by previously proposed passive learners. We prove that the label complexity of MARMANN is significantly lower than that of any passive learner with similar error guarantees. MARMANN is based on a generalized sample compression scheme, and a new label-efficient active model-selection procedure.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低非参数主动学习的标签复杂度。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于样本压缩和主动模型选择的MARMANN算法。
summary_zh.result: 在理论保证下显著降低标签复杂度。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce label complexity in nonparametric active learning while maintaining prediction error guarantees.
summary_en.method: A generalized sample compression scheme combined with a label-efficient active model-selection procedure.
summary_en.result: The proposed MARMANN algorithm achieves significantly lower label complexity than passive learners with comparable error guarantees.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proofs of error and label complexity bounds.
